finding: Capture condition (lateral <= radial_clearance at a control tick) never fires: closest approach is 3.03e-6 m outside the threshold, yet the peg seats. The test premise depends on a trajectory clearing a threshold by microns.
suspected_cause: Platform floating-point sensitivity (same class as the three R05 last-ULP drift failures); versions match uv.lock, so CPU/compiler-level differences are suspected but not isolated.
measurement_note: Lateral computed from logged tip_pos; the code tests the mouth projection along the peg axis, which was not logged. Not re-instrumented (behavior-freeze area).
